STS1_BIG_FISH.title: Big Fish
STS1_BIG_FISH.pages.INITIAL.description: You come across a giant fish blocking your path. It stares at you with curious eyes.
STS1_BIG_FISH.pages.INITIAL.options.BANA: Heal for 1/3 of your max HP.
STS1_BIG_FISH.pages.BANANA.description: You eat the banana. It's delicious! You feel refreshed.
STS1_BIG_FISH.pages.DONUT.description: You eat the donut. It's surprisingly filling! You feel stronger.
STS1_BIG_FISH.pages.SHOE.description: You search the shoe and find something useful... and something cursed.
STS1_GOLDEN_IDOL.title: Golden Idol
STS1_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.INITIAL.descripti: You find a golden idol resting on a pedestal. It glimmers in the dim light.
STS1_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.INITIAL.options.T: Obtain Golden Idol. Trigger a trap.
STS1_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.TRAP.description: As you grab the idol, a trap is triggered! Boulders begin to fall!
STS1_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.SMASH.description: You smash through the falling rocks, but take a hit in the process.
STS1_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.JUMP.description: You leap out of the way, but a boulder clips you.
STS1_GOLDEN_IDOL.pages.DESTROY.descripti: You shield yourself, but the impact weakens you permanently.
STS1_THE_CLERIC.title: The Cleric
STS1_THE_CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: A robed figure approaches you. "I can offer you healing... for a price."
STS1_THE_CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.options.HE: Pay 35 gold. Heal 25% of your max HP.
STS1_THE_CLERIC.pages.INITIAL.options.PU: Pay 50 gold. Remove a card from your deck.
STS1_THE_CLERIC.pages.HEAL.description: The cleric places their hands on you. You feel a warm glow.
STS1_THE_CLERIC.pages.PURIFY.description: The cleric chants softly. You feel lighter.
STS1_GOLDEN_WING.title: Golden Wing
STS1_GOLDEN_WING.pages.INITIAL.descripti: A golden feather floats down from above. It shimmers with arcane energy.
STS1_GOLDEN_WING.pages.ACCEPT.descriptio: The feather dissolves into your mind, granting you knowledge.
STS1_LIVING_WALL.title: Living Wall
STS1_LIVING_WALL.pages.INITIAL.descripti: A wall of living vines blocks your path. It speaks: "I can help you... but you must choose."
STS1_LIVING_WALL.pages.INITIAL.options.F: Remove a card from your deck.
STS1_LIVING_WALL.pages.INITIAL.options.C: Transform a card in your deck.
STS1_LIVING_WALL.pages.INITIAL.options.T: Upgrade a card in your deck.
STS1_LIVING_WALL.pages.FORGET.descriptio: The vines reach into your mind and pull something away.
STS1_LIVING_WALL.pages.CHANGE.descriptio: The vines wrap around a card and transform it.
STS1_LIVING_WALL.pages.TRADE.description: The vines enhance one of your cards.
STS1_OLD_BEGGAR.title: Old Beggar
STS1_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: An old beggar sits by the road. "Spare some gold? I can make your troubles disappear."
STS1_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.INITIAL.options.OF: Pay 75 gold. Remove a card from your deck.
STS1_OLD_BEGGAR.pages.OFFER_GOLD.descrip: The beggar takes your gold and mutters a spell. One of your cards vanishes.
STS1_THE_WOMAN_IN_BLUE.title: The Woman in Blue
STS1_THE_WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.INITIAL.des: A woman in a blue robe offers you potions from her collection.
STS1_THE_WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.INITIAL.opt: Pay 20 gold. Obtain a random potion.
Pay 30 gold. Obtain a random potion.
Pay 40 gold. Obtain a random potion.
STS1_THE_WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.BUY_1.descr: You purchase a potion. It bubbles ominously.
STS1_THE_WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.BUY_2.descr: You purchase another potion. The woman smiles.
STS1_THE_WOMAN_IN_BLUE.pages.BUY_3.descr: You purchase a final potion. The woman nods approvingly.
STS1_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.title: Bonfire Spirits
STS1_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.INITIAL.descr: Spectral spirits dance around a bonfire. They beckon you closer.
STS1_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.INITIAL.optio: Remove a card from your deck. Heal to full HP.
STS1_BONFIRE_SPIRITS.pages.OFFER.descrip: The spirits consume your card and bathe you in warm light. You feel fully restored.
STS1_DIVINE_FOUNTAIN.title: Divine Fountain
STS1_DIVINE_FOUNTAIN.pages.INITIAL.descr: A beautiful fountain stands before you. The water glows with a soft, divine light.
STS1_DIVINE_FOUNTAIN.pages.INITIAL.optio: Remove all Curses from your deck.
STS1_DIVINE_FOUNTAIN.pages.PRAY.descript: You kneel before the fountain. The divine water washes away your curses.
STS1_DUPLICATOR.title: Duplicator
STS1_DUPLICATOR.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: A strange machine hums before you. It seems capable of copying things.
STS1_DUPLICATOR.pages.INITIAL.options.DU: Choose a card in your deck. Obtain a copy of it.
STS1_DUPLICATOR.pages.DUPLICATE.descript: The machine whirs to life and produces an exact copy of your card.
STS1_FACE_TRADER.title: Face Trader
STS1_FACE_TRADER.pages.INITIAL.descripti: A mysterious merchant displays a collection of strange masks.
STS1_FACE_TRADER.pages.INITIAL.options.T: Obtain a random face relic. Lose 10% max HP.
STS1_FACE_TRADER.pages.TRADE.description: You try on a mask. It fuses with your face. You feel... different.
STS1_FOUNTAIN_OF_CLEANSING.title: Fountain of Cleansing
STS1_FOUNTAIN_OF_CLEANSING.pages.INITIAL: A fountain of clear water bubbles before you. It radiates purification energy.
Remove all Curses from your deck. Lose 10% max HP.
STS1_FOUNTAIN_OF_CLEANSING.pages.DRINK.d: The water cleanses you, but the purification process weakens your body.
STS1_THE_MAUSOLEUM.title: The Mausoleum
STS1_THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.INITIAL.descrip: An ancient mausoleum stands before you. Its stone coffin is sealed shut.
STS1_THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.INITIAL.options: 50% chance: Obtain a random relic. 50% chance: Obtain a Curse.
STS1_THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.OPEN_RELIC.desc: Inside the coffin you find a gleaming relic!
STS1_THE_MAUSOLEUM.pages.OPEN_CURSE.desc: A dark energy escapes the coffin and curses you!
STS1_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.title: Wheel of Change
STS1_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.INITIAL.descr: A large, colorful wheel stands before you. Strange symbols decorate its surface.
STS1_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.GOLD.descript: The wheel lands on gold! Coins rain down upon you.
STS1_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.DAMAGE.descri: The wheel lands on a skull! You feel a sharp pain.
STS1_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.RELIC.descrip: The wheel lands on a treasure chest! A relic appears.
STS1_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.CURSE.descrip: The wheel lands on a dark symbol! A curse afflicts you.
STS1_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.HEAL.descript: The wheel lands on a heart! You feel rejuvenated.
STS1_WHEEL_OF_CHANGE.pages.REMOVE.descri: The wheel lands on a card with an X. One of your cards vanishes.
STS1_DESIGNER.title: Designer
STS1_DESIGNER.pages.INITIAL.description: A skilled artisan offers to modify your cards.
STS1_DESIGNER.pages.INITIAL.options.REMO: Pay 50 gold. Choose a card to remove.
STS1_THE_LAB.title: The Lab
STS1_THE_LAB.pages.INITIAL.description: You discover an abandoned laboratory. Shelves of potions line the walls.
STS1_THE_LAB.pages.OPEN.description: You grab three potions from the shelves. They glow with various colors.
STS1_SHINING_LIGHT.title: Shining Light
STS1_SHINING_LIGHT.pages.INITIAL.descrip: A brilliant light emanates from a crack in the ceiling. It seems to enhance things it touches.
STS1_SHINING_LIGHT.pages.INITIAL.options: Take 30% of max HP as damage. Upgrade 2 random cards.
STS1_SHINING_LIGHT.pages.ENTER.descripti: The light burns you, but your cards glow with new power.
STS1_MUSHROOMS.title: Mushrooms
STS1_MUSHROOMS.pages.INITIAL.description: A cluster of strange mushrooms grows in the damp corridor.
STS1_MUSHROOMS.pages.INITIAL.options.EAT: 50% chance: Gain 5 max HP. 50% chance: Lose 5 max HP, gain a potion.
STS1_MUSHROOMS.pages.EAT_GOOD.descriptio: The mushrooms were delicious! You feel stronger.
STS1_MUSHROOMS.pages.EAT_BAD.description: The mushrooms were poisonous! You feel weaker, but find a potion nearby.
STS1_DEAD_ADVENTURER.title: Dead Adventurer
STS1_DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.INITIAL.descr: You find the remains of a fallen adventurer. Their belongings are scattered around.
STS1_DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.INITIAL.optio: Chance for gold, relic, or an elite encounter.
STS1_DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.GOLD.descript: You find some gold on the body.
STS1_DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.RELIC.descrip: You find a relic among the belongings!
STS1_DEAD_ADVENTURER.pages.FIGHT.descrip: The noise attracts an elite enemy!
STS1_SCORPION_NEST.title: Scorpion Nest
STS1_SCORPION_NEST.pages.INITIAL.descrip: You stumble upon a nest of giant scorpions.
STS1_TREASURE_OOZE.title: Treasure Ooze
STS1_TREASURE_OOZE.pages.INITIAL.descrip: A massive slime blocks the path. Something shiny glows inside it.
STS1_TREASURE_OOZE.pages.INITIAL.options: Pay 50 gold. Obtain a random relic.
Fight a large slime. Reward: gold + relic.
STS1_JOUST.title: Joust
STS1_JOUST.pages.INITIAL.description: Two knights prepare to joust. You can place a bet.
STS1_JOUST.pages.WIN.description: Your bet pays off! You collect your winnings.
STS1_JOUST.pages.LOSE.description: Your bet loses. The crowd cheers as you walk away empty-handed.
STS1_THE_SSSSSERPENT.title: The Ssssserpent
STS1_THE_SSSSSERPENT.pages.INITIAL.descr: A giant serpent coils before you. "Sssshall we make a deal?"
STS1_THE_SSSSSERPENT.pages.ACCEPT.descri: Gold pours from the serpent's mouth. Doubt creeps into your mind.
STS1_ALTAR.title: Altar
STS1_ALTAR.pages.INITIAL.description: A blood-stained altar stands in the center of the room. Dark energy pulses from it.
STS1_ALTAR.pages.INITIAL.options.SACRIFI: Remove a card. Gain a random relic.
STS1_ALTAR.pages.PRAY.description: The altar's energy flows into your cards, enhancing them greatly.
STS1_ALTAR.pages.SACRIFICE.description: You offer a card to the altar. A relic materializes from the blood.
STS1_COUNCIL_OF_GHOSTS.title: Council of Ghosts
STS1_COUNCIL_OF_GHOSTS.pages.INITIAL.des: A circle of ghosts surrounds you. They offer you their essence.
STS1_COUNCIL_OF_GHOSTS.pages.ACCEPT.desc: The ghosts dissolve into you. You feel ethereal... but fragile.
STS1_CURSED_TOME.title: Cursed Tome
STS1_CURSED_TOME.pages.INITIAL.descripti: A thick tome sits on a pedestal. Dark energy seeps from its pages.
STS1_CURSED_TOME.pages.INITIAL.options.R: Take 10 HP damage. Obtain a random rare relic.
STS1_CURSED_TOME.pages.READ.description: The knowledge burns your mind, but you find a powerful relic inside.
STS1_DRUG_DEALER.title: Drug Dealer
STS1_DRUG_DEALER.pages.INITIAL.descripti: A shady figure offers you a selection of potions.
STS1_DRUG_DEALER.pages.INITIAL.options.B: Pay gold for all available potions.
STS1_DRUG_DEALER.pages.BUY_ALL.descripti: You purchase the entire stock. The dealer disappears into the shadows.
STS1_FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.title: Forgotten Altar
STS1_FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.INITIAL.descr: An ancient altar covered in dust. Faint symbols glow on its surface.
STS1_FORGOTTEN_ALTAR.pages.INITIAL.optio: Gain 3 max HP. Obtain a Curse (Doubt).
Gain a random relic. Lose 10% max HP.
STS1_THE_GHOST.title: The Ghost
STS1_THE_GHOST.pages.INITIAL.description: A translucent figure appears before you. It offers you a gift.
STS1_THE_GHOST.pages.ACCEPT.description: The ghost hands you a glowing card and fades away.
STS1_KNOWING_SKULL.title: Knowing Skull
STS1_KNOWING_SKULL.pages.INITIAL.descrip: A glowing skull sits on a shelf. Its eyes flicker with intelligence.
STS1_KNOWING_SKULL.pages.INITIAL.options: Take 6 HP damage. Obtain a random rare card.
STS1_NEST.title: Nest
STS1_NEST.pages.INITIAL.description: A large nest filled with shiny objects sits in the corner.
STS1_NEST.pages.INITIAL.options.SEARCH.d: Obtain a random relic. Gain 2 Curses.
STS1_NEST.pages.SEARCH.description: You find a relic among the eggs, but the creatures curse you as you flee.
STS1_THE_LIBRARY.title: The Library
STS1_THE_LIBRARY.pages.INITIAL.descripti: A vast library stretches before you. Countless books line the walls.
STS1_THE_LIBRARY.pages.INITIAL.options.R: Choose 1 of 20 random cards. Add it to your deck.
STS1_THE_LIBRARY.pages.READ.description: You find an interesting book and learn a new technique.
STS1_THE_LIBRARY.pages.REST.description: You rest among the books. The quiet is soothing.
STS1_MASKED_BANDITS.title: Masked Bandits
STS1_MASKED_BANDITS.pages.INITIAL.descri: Three masked figures block your path. "Your gold or your life!"
STS1_MASKED_BANDITS.pages.INITIAL.option: Fight 3 bandits. Reward: gold + random relic.
STS1_NLOTH.title: N'loth
STS1_NLOTH.pages.INITIAL.description: A strange creature with many eyes examines your relics hungrily.
STS1_NLOTH.pages.INITIAL.options.OFFER.d: Give up 1 relic. Obtain a random relic.
STS1_NLOTH.pages.OFFER.description: N'loth devours your relic and spits out a different one.
STS1_VAMPIRES.title: Vampires
STS1_VAMPIRES.pages.INITIAL.description: A group of vampires emerges from the shadows. "Join us... or leave."
STS1_VAMPIRES.pages.INITIAL.options.ACCE: Remove all Strikes. Gain 5 Bites. Lose 30% max HP.
STS1_VAMPIRES.pages.ACCEPT.description: The vampires transform you. Your Strikes become Bites. You feel weaker but more versatile.
STS1_ANCIENT_WRITING.title: Ancient Writing
STS1_ANCIENT_WRITING.pages.INITIAL.descr: Strange writing covers the walls. It seems to respond to your touch.
STS1_ANCIENT_WRITING.pages.INITIAL.optio: Remove a card from your deck.
STS1_AUGMENTER.title: Augmenter
STS1_AUGMENTER.pages.INITIAL.description: A strange machine hums with experimental energy.
STS1_SENSORY_STONE.title: Sensory Stone
STS1_SENSORY_STONE.pages.INITIAL.descrip: A glowing stone pulses with psychic energy. Images flash through your mind.
STS1_SENSORY_STONE.pages.TOUCH.descripti: Visions flood your mind. You choose one to remember.
STS1_FALLING.title: Falling
STS1_FALLING.pages.INITIAL.description: The ground crumbles beneath you! You're falling!
STS1_FALLING.pages.INITIAL.options.LET_G: Remove a card from your deck.
STS1_FALLING.pages.INITIAL.options.HOLD_: Take 30% of max HP as damage.
STS1_FALLING.pages.INITIAL.options.FLY.d: Transform a card in your deck.
STS1_MIND_BLOOM.title: Mind Bloom
STS1_MIND_BLOOM.pages.INITIAL.descriptio: A strange fungus grows on the walls. It whispers promises of power.
STS1_MIND_BLOOM.pages.INITIAL.options.WA: Fight a boss from Act 1. Reward: relic.
STS1_MIND_BLOOM.pages.INITIAL.options.AW: Upgrade all cards in your deck.
STS1_MOAI_HEAD.title: Moai Head
STS1_MOAI_HEAD.pages.INITIAL.description: A giant stone head rises from the ground. Its eyes glow with ancient power.
STS1_MYSTERIOUS_SPHERE.title: Mysterious Sphere
STS1_MYSTERIOUS_SPHERE.pages.INITIAL.des: A floating sphere of energy hovers before you. Something moves inside it.
STS1_MYSTERIOUS_SPHERE.pages.INITIAL.opt: Fight 2 Orb Walkers. Reward: random relic.
STS1_TOMB_OF_LORD_RED_MASK.title: Tomb of Lord Red Mask
STS1_TOMB_OF_LORD_RED_MASK.pages.INITIAL: An ornate tomb bears the inscription: "Lord Red Mask awaits your offering."
Pay 50 gold. Gain a random relic.
Give all gold. Gain a random relic.
STS1_WINDING_HALLS.title: Winding Halls
STS1_WINDING_HALLS.pages.INITIAL.descrip: The corridors twist and turn in impossible ways. Madness lurks in every shadow.
STS1_WINDING_HALLS.pages.INITIAL.options: Gain 2 Madness cards. Lose 5% max HP.
Take 20% of max HP as damage.
STS1_TRANSMOGRIFIER.title: Transmogrifier
STS1_TRANSMOGRIFIER.pages.INITIAL.descri: A strange device hums with transformation energy.
STS1_TRANSMOGRIFIER.pages.TRANSFORM.desc: The device transforms your card into something new.
STS1_UPGRADE_SHRINE.title: Upgrade Shrine
STS1_UPGRADE_SHRINE.pages.INITIAL.descri: A shrine dedicated to improvement glows with warm light.
STS1_UPGRADE_SHRINE.pages.PRAY.descripti: The shrine's energy enhances your chosen card.
